planted.contains: Callers pass the raw header value exactly as received.

description: parse_bearer's docstring says callers pass the raw header value and that surrounding whitespace gets the request refused; its one caller, api.get_snippet, strips RFC 9110 optional whitespace first (spec.md H3), which is the correct behaviour. The docstring misdescribes its caller: the #453 D2 defect. Detected when IC1 fails citing both files.
